name: Katsuragi Sorako
source:
Hobbies: Cooking (specializes in Western and Japanese cooking)
Skills: Overhearing things even from a great distance
Likes: Cute things, tea
Dislikes: Nothing in particular

7th-year student who is the Crowns' prized treasurer. She is one of the eldest students of the recently-established Amakawa Noble Academy, standing up there alongside [url=/c17298]Saku[/url]. Her father is the famously wealthy Niiyama Katsuragi, so she's a bonafide noble in her own right.

Nobody really knows why she dresses in men's clothing, but she certainly doesn't act like one, as she's a girly girl through and through. She's best friends with Saku. Though in some ways, they couldn't be more different, with Sorako having a bit of a naive side to her. Her boundless kindness toward others means that when she spots someone in trouble, she can't help reach out to them to try and help in whatever ways she can. It's literally impossible for her to be on bad terms with anyone. She's even willing to hang out with [url=/c17297]Shinri[/url], despite him being the Crowns' "sworn enemy."

Aside from Saku, Sorako is considered the greatest talent at The Academy. Exercise is her weak point, and she's much clumsier than one might assume at a glance. Shinri sees through her clothes with great ease, and discovers her to be the owner of a pair of massive mammaries; her disguises are powerless before his discerning eye. Her favorite things in life are helping others, and a nice cup of tea after a meal. She sometimes even wears glasses, giving her the "Bespectacled Beauty" attribute, which is highly prized by fellows of good taste.

"Study me to your heart's content."

[Edited from [url=https://hello.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]official English page[/url]]
